summary: Iteration 190 Backend Testing Complete - BUG #1 (Mute einzelner Teilnehmer) VERIFIED. All WS broadcasts for mute_user, disable_camera_user, remove_user working correctly. BUG #2 (Virtual Background publishing) verified via code review - frontend components lint clean and implementation correct.

BUG_1_mute_einzelner_teilnehmer.details: PUT /meetings/{id}/participants/{uid} with mic_on=false now broadcasts {type: 'host-control', action: 'mute_user', target_user_id: uid, by: hostname, by_id: hostid} via WebSocket. Frontend handler (LiveMeetingPage.js lines 517-529) correctly disables LiveKit microphone and local audio tracks when receiving this broadcast.

BUG_1_camera_disable.details: PUT with camera_on=false broadcasts {action: 'disable_camera_user'}. Frontend handler (lines 530-540) disables LiveKit camera and local video tracks.

BUG_1_remove_user.details: PUT with role='removed' broadcasts {action: 'remove_user'}. Frontend handler (lines 541-545) shows toast and calls handleLeave() after 2s delay.

BUG_1_authorization.details: Non-host/co-host participants receive 403 when trying to update other participants. Backend check at lines 319-321 validates role.

BUG_2_virtual_background_publishing.details: VirtualBgCanvas.js exposes canvas via onCanvasReady callback (lines 27-35). LiveMeetingPage.js useEffect (lines 769-832) captures canvas stream at 30fps and calls localVideoTrack.replaceTrack() to publish composited video to LiveKit. When virtualBg='none', original camera track is restored. Both files pass ESLint with no errors.

regression_tests.iter190_regression_endpoints: 7/7 PASS (news, surveys, meetings, chat, 2fa, booking, calendar)
regression_tests.total: 15/15 PASS (some skipped due to rate limiting)

critical_code_review_comments: BUG #1 FIX CORRECT: Backend update_participant (core.py lines 330-349) now broadcasts host-control messages for mute_user, disable_camera_user, remove_user when host/co-host updates another participant
SELF-MUTE EXCLUDED: Broadcast only fires when user_id != current_user['user_id'] (line 330), preventing self-mute broadcasts
FRONTEND HANDLER CORRECT: LiveMeetingPage.js WS handler (lines 517-545) properly disables LiveKit tracks AND local stream tracks when receiving targeted mute/camera/remove actions
BUG #2 FIX CORRECT: VirtualBgCanvas.js onCanvasReady callback exposes canvas element to parent for captureStream()
LIVEKIT TRACK REPLACE: LiveMeetingPage.js useEffect (lines 769-832) correctly uses localVideoTrack.replaceTrack() to swap camera feed with composited canvas stream
CLEANUP HANDLED: Canvas stream tracks are properly stopped when switching back to 'none' or when component unmounts
